scope_note: Built and tested in this repository on 2026-10-06 (G1 platform kit); every cited path exists here.
title: Offline kit-event/1 analytics report
summary: GameKit/Telemetry maps kit events to kit-event/1 lines; tools/analytics_report.py turns a JSONL file of them into funnel, session and economy summaries with test traffic excluded. Live AnalyticsService delivery is T4 and owner-verified only.
limitations: AnalyticsService ingestion and dashboards need a published game (T4).

scope_note: Observed while building the runtime kits in this repository on 2026-10-06 with Lune 0.10.5; the specs that pin each workaround exist here.
title: Lune 0.10.5 differs from the engine in ways that break kit specs
summary: A module's first require yields in Lune, so a FakeEnv-spawned thread that loads a kit parks forever; CFrame.lookAt mirrors the Z component; reading TextLabel.Font or AbsoluteSize raises; UIScale.Scale is stored as float32; there is no StyleRule:SetProperties, RaycastParams, Workspace:Raycast or BindToSimulation. Specs preload kits at top level, build camera frames with CFrame.fromMatrix, and pass stand-ins; the engine half stays a T3 probe.
lesson: Never treat a Lune pass of an engine-facing module as engine evidence; keep the probe pending until Studio prints ENGINE_DONE.
